name: bilibili-mcp-agent
description: A local MCP server that gives agents structured access to Bilibili discovery, media metadata, public content, account reads, and explicitly gated interactions.

interface.longDescription: A local Model Context Protocol server for Bilibili search, videos, subtitles, danmaku, comments, users, favorites, dynamics, articles, live rooms, account reads, and explicitly confirmed write operations.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the Bilibili MCP tools to search, inspect, and organize Bilibili content. Ask before any account-changing action.
